title: Westcott–Hort 1881 Greek New Testament — Maurice A. Robinson transcription
attribution: Westcott and Hort, The New Testament in the Original Greek (1881); digital transcription by Maurice A. Robinson; maintained at byztxt/greektext-westcott-hort (Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen)
notes: Default Greek NT counterpart for Phase 1–2 (JAK-15 / JAK-24) — not SBLGNT. Upstream README declares Public Domain. Version pin is the git commit SHA of byztxt/greektext-westcott-hort. Checksum is sha256 of textonly/JOH.WH at that commit (primary pilot book). Additional pins at same commit: textonly/MR.WH sha256:8cbc2eeb9d5f4dbadbcd44694ba5f82dc94bc5222b0a6a6e95c9e0b93529f9c2; textonly/MT.WH sha256:fae66d7f522e2763ce54b14fa69cc8ee38f642454060034023c085fa87314da9. Textonly files use Robinson beta code (y=θ, c=χ, v=final ς); ingest converts to Unicode. Morphological parsed/*.UWH files are available upstream but unused in this pilot. Local path after setup: data/downloads/westcott-hort/textonly/. Redistributable pilot excerpt under data/sources/pilot/.
editor: B. F. Westcott & F. J. A. Hort; transcription M. A. Robinson
